name: Quarryman Hal

intro.text: Honey-coloured limestone? Not just pretty, you know. Real stone, real work, and I intend to do a bit more of it to you.

win: Hard stone, hard luck. Well fought.
after: Cotswold stone comes out of the ground soft and full of quarry water, and hardens as it dries in the air. Quarrymen like to dig it in the autumn, so the frost can't split it before it sets.
